text.en:
Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload.

Fires a large Freezing Orb that travels for 6 seconds and moves at a rate of 9.5 meters per second. The orb fires <stasis/>Freezing projectiles every 0.5 seconds at any non-frozen target within a 10 meter radius of it. Projectiles deal <pve 60 /> <pvp [11] /> damage and have a 3 meter freezing radius.

Freezing Orb deals <pve 1282 /> <pvp [250] /> damage on impact and detonates in a 10 meter radius, applying <stasis/>60 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance).

Grants 25% Glaive Energy on each hit with either the orb or its projectiles.
